response.justification: Bogdan is a talented, versatile full-stack engineer with strong open-source and mentoring credentials, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role, which requires 8 years of C++ programming and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/distributed systems/compute experience. His career has centered on web/mobile/full-stack development (Node.js, TypeScript, DLang, Ember.js) with only brief early-career C++ exposure (National Instruments, ~6 months) and no evident cloud compute platform or infrastructure-at-scale leadership experience.
strengths: Extensive polyglot software craftsmanship experience with strong testing culture (TDD, CI/CD)
Demonstrated mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, talks, and open-source projects
Founder-level experience owning and architecting a platform (GISCollective) end-to-end
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months at National Instruments) versus required 8 years
No demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform or distributed infrastructure leadership
Career trajectory is full-stack/web/mobile focused, not aligned with compute/infrastructure technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform experience
Strong mentoring, leadership, and technical breadth
